CREATE TABLE "public"."pantry_items" (
  "category" text DEFAULT 'General' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "frequencyDays" int4 DEFAULT 7 NOT NULL,
  "frequencyLabel" text DEFAULT 'Weekly (7d)' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inShoppingList" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "inStock" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lastPurchasedAt" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nextDueDate" timestamptz,
  "notes" text,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "shoppingListQuantity" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text DEFAULT 'items' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
